title: Defence not available with previous knowledge
description: Defence of ordinary course of business not available if person had previous knowledge of order

content.general_rule: A person is not liable to penalty if they published an advertisement in the ordinary course of business
content.exception: Such defence is not available if the person had previous knowledge of the order passed by the Central Authority
conditions: previous knowledge of the order passed by the Central Authority for withdrawal or modification of such advertisement
